overview: The Medford School Committee approved updated job descriptions and a contract extension for Teamsters Local 25 administrators, approved student travel to the National Ethics Bowl, and voted to increase before- and after-school tuition rates while reviewing an excessive heat protocol.

items.title: Executive Session for Labor Negotiations
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding contract negotiations with administrators, secretaries, custodians, and cafeteria workers.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Member Reinfeld inquired about the scheduling of a budget presentation, which Vice Chair Graham noted she would coordinate with the mayor and superintendent.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and the school committee meeting minutes from February 12, 2024.

items.title: Teamsters Local 25 Administrator Job Descriptions and MOA
items.summary: The committee approved revised job descriptions and a memorandum of agreement extending the contract through the 2024–2025 school year for Teamsters Local 25 administrators.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented updates on district events, athletic achievements, Women's History Month, and upcoming early release schedules.

items.title: National Ethics Bowl Student Travel Approval
items.summary: The committee approved student travel to the University of North Carolina for the National Ethics Bowl competition and voted to explore creating a donation link for community contributions.

items.title: Before and After School Program Update and Tuition Approval
items.summary: The committee approved a tuition increase of one dollar per day for before- and after-school programs following a program report, and voted to receive a program capacity update in May.

items.title: Revised Excessive Heat Protocol
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing presented a revised excessive heat protocol and associated equipment costs for committee review and feedback.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of assistant football coach Joe Rossetti, Denise Parr, and former teacher and coach Fred Knox.
